assertion.statement: The constructed full-three quotient has generic fibre equal over Q to the canonical full adelic level-three curve Y3 on all determinant components, with the actual universal structures and the same marked coarse j-map; the temporary five-level is forgotten.
assertion.objects: The fixed B=(2,-3), O=Z[i,(1+j)/2], mu=2j+ij and the actual positive principal datum; the curves and markings specified in this source interface.
assertion.hypotheses: The actual integral construction and corrected principal datum, the cited Deligne PEL/Riemann/canonical-model inputs, finite marking descent, and only the independent local normalizer classes/center calculation (not the degree conclusion).
assertion.quantifiers: The fixed discriminant-six construction and every object or component in the stated interface.
assertion.parameter_range: Exactly the base, locus and level stated in the conclusion; no extension to other quaternion discriminants.
assertion.uniformity: The same principal datum, marking convention and coordinate are retained throughout; no object or component is replaced.
assertion.constants: Only the explicit fixed coefficients, levels and weights in the statement.
assertion.normalizations: Actual principal form E, not6E; left O-module markings with right-multiplication relabeling where applicable; the uniquely ordered coarse coordinate j.
assertion.exceptional_cases: An arbitrary complex isomorphism is not descended. The proof constructs the Q-map through a fine Siegel model. No degree estimate or tame integral quotient is assumed or supplied.
assertion.limit_order: Use inverse frames and matching actions, construct the actual Q-morphism, compare canonical image, descend the isomorphism and quotient five-level before using the separate degree bound.
